historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes packages and user involvement but materially expands scope, embeds password automation and truncates evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores the source identity/link boundary and separates state-changing operations.

original_test_intent: Confirm the expected BlueField DPU is enumerated at its approved PCIe address and its complete identity and link information match the platform specification.
original_method: Identify BlueField serial/SKU/BDF and authoritative SPEC; preserve baseline logs; decide whether updating the PCI ID database is permitted; collect full lspci identity and verbose link/capability output for the verified BDF; compare fields explicitly and retain postcheck logs without installing firmware.
manual_activity: DPU/platform owner supplies exact identity/BDF/SPEC and decides whether PCI-ID database update is permitted; any firmware activity belongs to a separate approved case.
required_inputs: BlueField serial/SKU and verified PCIe BDF
Authoritative expected vendor/device/subsystem IDs, generation, width and speed
Approval for update-pciids or an offline pinned ID database
Protected evidence path and baseline logs
safety_requirements: Never infer the BDF from grep alone
Treat update-pciids as a package/database change
Do not install or flash DOCA/BFB in this check
Preserve full lspci output and logs
Stop on disappearance, link downgrade or new PCIe error; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture read-only full PCIe identity and link evidence
Do not install, flash or reboot without separate authorization
engineer_actions: Own any separate firmware change and final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its install/flash/reboot path is outside the Master row, sshpass/host-key bypass is unsafe and head truncates the required evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use full `lspci -Dnn` inventory, then `lspci -D -s <verified-BDF> -nnvvv` and supported devlink read-only output; update PCI IDs only if separately approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The DPU connection check, 15-minute allocations and SPEC comparison remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the check to serial/SKU/BDF, capture full machine-readable and verbose PCIe evidence, and compare a declared field matrix to the recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target provenance, explicit expected fields, no-clear evidence and a change boundary around update-pciids.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A package/firmware install or generic Mellanox grep cannot replace exact BlueField identity/link verification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Shared vendor IDs can select the wrong adapter; updating the ID database changes host state and link details may vary with topology.

project_override_considerations: Networking owner must define expected BlueField generation, IDs, BDF/topology and negotiated PCIe width/speed and decide whether update-pciids is allowed.
expected_evidence: Full lspci inventory and exact-BDF verbose output

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master is an enumeration/link-information check; DeepSeek recasts it as DOCA/BFB installation, firmware flash and reboot, changing both intent and blast radius.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if exact BlueField identity/BDF/SPEC or safe read-only access cannot be established. Missing pciutils or approval remains provisionable.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row384 Wistron-Networking-00373-V003: approve exact BlueField serial/SKU/BDF and expected PCI identity/link fields, whether `update-pciids` is allowed or an offline pinned database is required, and keep any DOCA/BFB/firmware flash/reboot outside this read-only connection check unless separately authorized.

review_improvement: Turns a loose grep into a target-bound, field-by-field PCIe identity/link verification while preventing an unrelated destructive firmware workflow from absorbing the case.
independent_technical_reasoning: BlueField discovery by product text is not sufficient because multiple Mellanox devices may coexist and PCI ID names depend on a mutable database. The stable proof is the approved serial/SKU-to-BDF map plus numeric IDs and negotiated link data; firmware deployment is a separate state transition.
